name: TNT Arsenal
description: Forty-two kinds of TNT, each with its own hand-drawn look and its own way of going off: from Mega, Giga and Nuke to drills, tunnels, bridges, castle walls, black holes, meteors, x-ray, harvesters and lumberjacks. Bedrock, obsidian and chests are never touched. Crafted at the table, so JEI and REI show every recipe.
